description: This file provides inline functions for checking internal register addresses and performing IO memory remapping specific to RTL838X hardware in a Linux kernel environment.

methods.name: int is_rtl838x_internal_registers(phys_addr_t offset)
methods.description: Checks if a given physical address offset corresponds to internal registers for RTL838X hardware.

methods.name: void __iomem * plat_ioremap(phys_addr_t offset,unsigned long size,unsigned long flags)
methods.description: Performs IO memory mapping for a given physical address offset, returning a pointer if internal registers are detected.

methods.name: int plat_iounmap(const volatile void __iomem * addr)
methods.description: Checks if a given IO memory address is internal registers, used for unmapping.

ctags.name: plat_ioremap
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void __iomem *plat_ioremap(phys_addr_t offset, unsigned long size,$/
